(()=>{const w=document.querySelector('.architect-workspace');if(!w)throw Error('Architect workspace not mounted');const d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(w.dataset.designId)));const moved=d.walls.find(x=>x.a[1]===-2000&&x.b[1]===-2000);if(d.name!=='Unlock test')throw Error('Name not changed: '+d.name);if(typeof window.__roofsBefore==='number'&&d.roofs.length!==window.__roofsBefore)throw Error('Roof created by this request still present: '+d.roofs.length+' vs '+window.__roofsBefore);if(d.walls.length<8)throw Error('Expected >=8 walls, got '+d.walls.length);if(!moved)throw Error('Wall not moved to y=-2000');return {name:d.name,revision:d.revision,levels:d.levels.length,walls:d.walls.length,roofs:d.roofs.length,roofsBefore:window.__roofsBefore,moved:{id:moved.id,a:moved.a,b:moved.b}}})()
